body:
Tasks without a recorded PR whose stamped worktree is absent now appear as facts in the First Officer startup/idle watcher. The watcher no longer tells that session to record an unknown PR; local PR discovery and watching already recorded PRs keep their existing behavior.

Local validation (2026-11-13; [implementation report](https://github.com/iamcxa/kc-claude-plugins/blob/spacedock-state/dev2/pr-watch-tasks-foreign-worktree.md#stage-report-implementation)): four acceptance checks, 14 executed mutation checks, 1,412 unittest cases with 11 optional skips, and two native CLI checks. All CI test commands have passing results after the documented macOS temporary-path correction and narrow replay rerun; lint, ADR, number-guard and comment-ratio checks also pass.

RoboRev: run by FO because the Codex sandbox could not reach the local daemon: `clean on e1fbb6ee5; evidence=roborev:1806`.
